title: Justin Sun Prize Launches AI Math Research Pilot With Up to $1M Prizes
summary:
The Justin Sun Prize is collaborating with Caltech Professor Tony Yue Yu's MathDB platform to launch a pilot program for AI assisted mathematical research. The program implements a formal submission and review process for 50 mathematical problems divided into four award levels, with prize pools for those levels reaching up to $1M.

The initiative is part of a broader effort to incentivize artificial intelligence breakthroughs. Justin Sun said the prize was established with the goal of becoming the “Nobel Prize of the AI Era.”
